Yesterday I trained my own Jev style decision model by finetuning Qwen3.5-4B on the LocalLLaMA/typed-decisions dataset with 
@UnslothAI
 

added a decision head + trained with 4-bit QLoRA on a single A100 within 15 mins, 4 epochs -> 80% accuracy (2 Epochs are enough though)

Finetuned Qwen3.5-4B into a decision model like Jev using @UnslothAI. 

- 4-bit QLoRA, bf16, single A100, 15 min. 
- Train/val loss flatten after 2 epochs so most of the learning happens fast.
- Trained just 64.5M params (2.1%)
- accuracy jumps 30% -> 80% after 4 epochs on  x.com/UnslothAI/stat…
